hero.sub: Ten carriers rated at once, in about a second. Price a shipment right now — no account, no sales call.

q.hint: Country and weight is all we need
q.cta: Sign up to book this shipment

fan.title: We ask all of them at once, then keep the cheapest
fan.lead: Most aggregators hold one account per carrier. We hold several — different countries, different entities, different negotiated rates — and fan the request across every one of them that serves your lane.

fl.title: Whatever is in the box, there's a lane for it
fl.sub: From a next-day parcel across Riyadh to a pallet of regulated goods that needs a declaration someone has to sign.

lab.title: The quote you see is the amount the carrier invoices
lab.sub: Carriers bill on whichever is greater — what it weighs, or how much space it takes. Get the divisor wrong and every quote you give is a guess. Drag the box and watch.

how.title: Four steps, and you control all of them
how.note: Nothing reaches the carrier until your payment clears. No surprise waybills, no charge for a shipment you changed your mind about.

tr.title: Every piece tracked, every document generated
tr.sub: A 25-box shipment gets 25 tracking numbers and 25 labels, not one master and a shrug. The commercial invoice is built from your items and travels with the goods.

bz.title: Built for whoever reconciles it at month end
bz.sub: Terms, team control, store connections and paperwork — the parts that decide whether shipping is a line item or a mess.

st.title: One account is the whole network

cta.title: Get a price in the next ten seconds
cta.sub: Individuals are approved on the spot. Companies are reviewed in one to two business days — and your shipment is waiting when you get in.
cta.fine: No card required for a quote.

empty: Enter a weight to see prices.

trk.label: Tracking number
trk.empty: Enter an ezhalha tracking number or a carrier waybill number.
trk.short: That does not look like a tracking number
trk.shortMsg: ezhalha numbers look like EZH100200300. Carrier waybills are 10 to 14 digits.
trk.none: No shipment found for that number
trk.noneMsg: Check the number and try again. A shipment can take a few minutes to appear after it is booked.
trk.privacy: Public tracking shows movement only. Addresses, contact details and prices stay inside your ezhalha account.

fanFacts.title: Every carrier on your lane
fanFacts.body: FedEx, DHL, Aramex and six domestic couriers, asked in parallel.

fanFacts.title: Every account under each carrier
fanFacts.body: Scoped by origin and destination country, then the cheapest one wins.

fanFacts.title: A carrier that stalls is dropped
fanFacts.body: Eight-second ceiling each. One slow API never holds up your quote.

flows.title: Express Shipment
flows.body: International courier delivery, import and export, through FedEx, DHL and Aramex. Live rates, full customs paperwork, door to door.

flows.title: Local Delivery
flows.body: Last-mile inside Saudi Arabia across six domestic couriers on fixed rate cards, so the price never moves on you.
flows.tag: 6 couriers · next day in major cities

flows.title: Door To Door Freight
flows.body: Import with all duties and taxes prepaid, on fixed lane pricing by air or by sea. Our team clears it and hands it over.

flows.title: Dangerous Goods
flows.body: Batteries, chemicals, aerosols. Declared under IATA rules and priced by a person who signs for it, not an API that guesses.

steps.title: Get rates
steps.body: Every carrier on your lane priced at once, with transit times and your all-in total.

steps.title: Check out
steps.body: Pick a rate. We hold it and build the shipment — nothing has reached the carrier yet.

steps.title: Pay
steps.body: Card through Tap, or on your credit terms. Saved cards and in-app payment supported.

steps.title: We book it
steps.body: Waybill, a label per piece, commercial invoice and a pickup — all generated for you.

biz.title: Ship now, settle later
biz.body: Approved accounts get a credit limit and 30-day terms. Invoices, statements and reminders run themselves — no chasing, no month-end surprises.

biz.title: Your team, your rules
biz.body: Six separate permissions: who creates shipments, who sees invoices, who is allowed to pay. The primary contact keeps control.

biz.title: Orders straight from your store
biz.body: Connect Zid or WooCommerce and orders arrive ready to ship. Pick the carrier, or set a rule — cheapest, fastest, or always the same one.

biz.title: Paperwork that fills itself
biz.body: Upload a supplier invoice and we read the items, HS codes, origins and values off it. The commercial invoice is generated and travels with the goods.

biz.title: VAT that is actually right
biz.body: Four separate tax treatments — domestic, import, export and freight. The margin is taxed correctly on each, so the books reconcile.

biz.title: People where people are needed
biz.body: Freight and dangerous goods are quoted by our operations desk, not a robot. You get a named price from someone accountable for it.
